<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="כסלו_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518915410_theRebbe_669" batchId="meluket-_D7_9B_D7_A1_D7_9C_D7_95_meluket__BH_POST_1766518915410_theRebbe_669__p006">
  <section v="15">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The revelation at the Resurrection of the Dead will be the disclosure of Atzmus drawn down through mitzvos in this world, similar to the revelation at the passing of tzaddikim who engaged in the inner dimensions of Torah.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And behold, the revelation that will be at the Resurrection of the Dead is</t>
    <t s="1">(as explained in many places,</t>
    <t s="2">and also in the aforementioned maamar),</t>
    <t s="3">that then will be revealed the drawing down of Atzmus that comes through the fulfillment of the commandments in this world.</t>
    <t s="4">And it is in the manner explained above</t>
    <t s="5">(section 7)</t>
    <t s="6">regarding the matter of the Hilula at the passing of the tzaddikim who engaged in the inner dimensions of Torah,</t>
    <t s="7">which is the revelation of the inwardness and the boundless aspect of the Torah and mitzvos that they engaged in in this world.</t>
    <t s="8">Except that now,</t>
    <t s="9">in order to receive the revelation, it is through the departure of the soul from the body,</t>
    <t s="10">but in the future this revelation will also be in the physical body</t>
    <t s="11">(and also the revelation itself will be more elevated,</t>
    <t s="12">for then there will be the revelation of Atzmus,</t>
    <t s="13">as above).</t>
  </section>
  <section v="16">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The concept of the third Hilula is explained in the discourse on the Hilula of Rashbi, hinting that the greatness of tzaddikim who reveal the inner Torah is expressed both at their passing and through their work while alive.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And it can be said,</t>
    <t s="1">that from the reasons that the matter of the third Hilula is explained in the discourse entitled "To Understand the Matter of the Hilula of Rashbi,"</t>
    <t s="2">it is</t>
    <t s="3">as a hint,</t>
    <t s="4">that the level of the tzaddikim whose main occupation is to reveal the inner dimensions of Torah is in two matters.</t>
    <t s="5">That the day of their passing is called by the name "Yom Hilula,"</t>
    <t s="6">because then the inwardness and the boundless aspect of the Torah and mitzvos is revealed,</t>
    <t s="7">as explained above at length.</t>
    <t s="8">And also,</t>
    <t s="9">that through their work to reveal the inner dimensions of Torah,</t>
    <t s="10">there is revealed</t>
    <t s="11">[in them,</t>
    <t s="12">and through them is revealed somewhat also to all those connected to them]</t>
    <t s="13">the boundless aspect of Torah and mitzvos also in the soul as it is clothed in the physical body,</t>
    <t s="14">and also in the physical body itself,</t>
    <t s="15">in the manner that it will be at the Resurrection of the Dead.</t>
    <t s="16">And it should be added,</t>
    <t s="17">that the revelation of these two matters,</t>
    <t s="18">also the matter of the Hilula of the passing,</t>
    <t s="19">is in the soul as it is clothed in the body.</t>
    <t s="20">Except that at first,</t>
    <t s="21">the revelation of the boundless aspect to the person is through his being in a movement of self-nullification,</t>
    <t s="22">that he goes out of his existence—in the manner of the matter of passing,</t>
    <t s="23">and through this,</t>
    <t s="24">afterwards the boundless aspect is revealed also in the existence of the person—in the manner of the revelation that will be at the Resurrection of the Dead.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="17">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>There are three levels in the ascent to the Infinite and boundless through Torah and mitzvos: hidden for those engaged in the revealed Torah, revealed at passing for those in the inner Torah, and ultimately revealed in their very existence.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">9)</t>
    <t s="1">And behold, from the above it is understood,</t>
    <t s="2">that in the aforementioned ascent</t>
    <t s="3">(the ascent in the aspect of Ein Sof and without limit)</t>
    <t s="4">that is accomplished through the fulfillment of Torah and mitzvos in this world,</t>
    <t s="5">there are three levels.</t>
    <t s="6">For in the souls that engage only in the revealed aspect of Torah,</t>
    <t s="7">the ascent is in concealment.</t>
    <t s="8">Because from the aspect of the externality</t>
    <t s="9">(the revealed aspect of Torah),</t>
    <t s="10">the Torah and mitzvos are in measure and limitation.</t>
    <t s="11">And the revelation of the boundless that is drawn down through the fulfillment of Torah and mitzvos in this world will be primarily in the future.</t>
    <t s="12">And in the souls that engage in the inner dimensions of Torah,</t>
    <t s="13">the revelation of the boundless aspect of Torah and mitzvos</t>
    <t s="14">(the matter of the ascent)</t>
    <t s="15">is also at the time of their passing,</t>
    <t s="16">and likewise while they are below through the movement of self-nullification and going out of their existence.</t>
    <t s="17">And through this they then come to a more elevated level,</t>
    <t s="18">that the revelation of the boundless aspect of Torah and mitzvos is also in their very existence.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
